name: EURUSD vs USDCHF Correlation Analysis
description: Analyzes the correlation between EURUSD and USDCHF across multiple timeframes (1 year, 3 years, 5 years) and shows how the correlation evolves over time using rolling correlation analysis.
source:
# EURUSD vs USDCHF Correlation Analysis
# Analyzes correlation between EURUSD and USDCHF across multiple timeframes

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Get close prices for each currency pair
# For correlation analysis, we need to work with returns or price changes
eurusd_close = close
usdchf_close = close

# Calculate daily returns for correlation analysis
eurusd_returns = roc(period=1)(eurusd_close)
usdchf_returns = roc(period=1)(usdchf_close)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATIONS - Multiple Timeframes
# =============================================================================

# 63-day rolling correlation (~3 months) - for showing correlation evolution
corr_63d = rolling_corr(window=63, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eurusd_returns, y=usdchf_returns)

# 252-day rolling correlation (~1 year)
corr_252d = rolling_corr(window=252, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eurusd_returns, y=usdchf_returns)

# 756-day rolling correlation (~3 years)
corr_756d = rolling_corr(window=756, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eurusd_returns, y=usdchf_returns)

# 1260-day rolling correlation (~5 years)
corr_1260d = rolling_corr(window=1260, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=eurusd_returns, y=usdchf_returns)

# =============================================================================
# CORRELATION STATISTICS
# =============================================================================

# Statistics on the 63-day rolling correlation (correlation volatility/evolution)
corr_63d_min = min(period=1260)(corr_63d)
corr_63d_max = max(period=1260)(corr_63d)
corr_63d_std = stddev(period=1260)(corr_63d)

# Statistics on 252-day rolling correlation
corr_252d_min = min(period=1260)(corr_252d)
corr_252d_max = max(period=1260)(corr_252d)
corr_252d_std = stddev(period=1260)(corr_252d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS - Key Correlation Metrics
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Correlation Metrics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current 1-Year Correlation", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current 3-Year Correlation", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current 5-Year Correlation", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Rolling Correlation", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Correlation Volatility", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(corr_252d, corr_756d, corr_1260d, corr_63d, corr_63d_std)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLE - Correlation Summary Statistics
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Correlation Summary Statistics",
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=["1-Year (252d)", "3-Year (756d)", "5-Year (1260d)"],
        col_headers=["Correlation Value", "Min Rolling Corr", "Max Rolling Corr", "Std Dev"],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: 1-Year stats
            ColumnSpec(title="1Y Correlation", grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="1Y Min", grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="1Y Max", grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="1Y Std", grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            # Row 1: 3-Year stats
            ColumnSpec(title="3Y Correlation", grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="3Y Min", grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="3Y Max", grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="3Y Std", grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            # Row 2: 5-Year stats
            ColumnSpec(title="5Y Correlation", grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="5Y Min", grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="5Y Max", grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="5Y Std", grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="Analysis"
)(corr_252d, corr_252d_min, corr_252d_max, corr_252d_std, corr_756d, corr_756d, corr_756d, corr_756d, corr_1260d, corr_1260d, corr_1260d, corr_1260d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS - Correlation Over Time
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Rolling Correlation Over Time (63-day and 252-day)
timeseries_lines(
    title="Rolling Correlation Over Time",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="63-Day Rolling Correlation", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="252-Day Rolling Correlation", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero Correlation", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1, title="Perfect Negative", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=1, title="Perfect Positive", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(corr_63d, corr_252d)

# Chart 2: Multiple Timeframe Correlations
timeseries_lines(
    title="Multiple Timeframe Correlations",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="1-Year (252d)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="3-Year (756d)", color=Color.Purple),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="5-Year (1260d)", color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero Correlation", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(corr_252d, corr_756d, corr_1260d)
